errors.conflict: Someone else changed this. The list was reloaded, so check it and try again.
errors.languageIsDefault: Can't switch off or delete the default language. Set another language as default first.
errors.languageInactive: Activate the language first before setting it as default.
errors.credentialsMissing: Fill in the required credentials first.
errors.providerInactive: Only an active provider can be the default.
errors.lockdownNoOfficial: Activate and configure at least one official paid provider (DeepL or Google Cloud) before enabling lockdown.
errors.planGate: Your plan does not include translation.

switcher.label: Change language
switcher.failed: The language could not be changed. Try again.

languages.description: Manage which languages new users and workspaces can pick. The "default" language is the fallback for every newly created account.

pack.title: Fixed at {count} languages
pack.body: Each active language is backed by a translation JSON file shipped with the platform. New language slots will appear here when the translation pack is extended.
pack.note: You can still toggle active state, edit native name + direction, and pick the platform default from the table on the left.

usedFor.title: How this is used
usedFor.body: Active languages show up in the user-side profile language switcher and in template / auto-reply pickers. The default applies to brand-new accounts that haven't picked one.

providers.title: Translation providers
providers.description: Multi-language auto-reply uses one of these providers to translate inbound messages and craft replies in the customer's language. MyMemory is active out-of-box (free, no key). Plug in DeepL / Google Cloud / LibreTranslate for higher quality or self-hosted privacy.

lockdown.title: Compliance lockdown
lockdown.description: When on, the fallback chain skips <mono>{slugs}</mono> and routes auto-reply translation only through official paid APIs (DeepL, Google Cloud). Required by some enterprise security policies that prohibit unofficial 3rd-party endpoints.
lockdown.confirmOn: Turn lockdown ON? Free drivers will be skipped — only paid APIs will translate.
lockdown.confirmOff: Turn lockdown OFF? Free drivers will rejoin the fallback chain.

empty.title: No translation providers configured
empty.body: Run the translation provider seed to populate this list.

providers.skippedTitle: Skipped because compliance lockdown is on.
providers.noCredentials: No credentials required — this provider works out of the box.
providers.sortOrderHint: Lower = higher priority in the fallback chain.

usage.title: Translation usage
usage.description: Volume + estimated cost of every auto-reply translation. Bundled dictionary hits and 24h cache hits aren't billable and don't appear here — these are the wire calls.
usage.badRange: The start date must not be after the end date.
usage.emptyProvider: No translation calls in this range.
usage.timelineHint: hover each bar for date / chars / cost
usage.emptyWorkspaces: No paid-tier translations in this range.

settings.title: Real-time translation
settings.description: Chat with customers in any language. Each side reads in their own language — automatically.

1.title: Customer writes (any language)
1.body: Their message is auto-translated INTO your team language and shown to your agent, with the original one click away.

2.title: Agent replies (your language)
2.body: Your reply is translated INTO the customer's language right before it is sent on WhatsApp.

3.title: AI + widget too
3.body: The AI agent and the website chat widget reply natively in the customer's language.

engine.body: You do NOT enter any API keys here — translation is configured once, platform-wide, and works out of the box automatically. A free engine is enabled by default; the platform can be set up to use DeepL / Google Translate for higher quality.

enabled.title: Auto-translate conversations
enabled.hint: Turn the whole thing on or off for this workspace.

teamLanguage.label: Your team language
teamLanguage.hint: The language YOUR agents read + write in. Customer messages are translated into this; your replies are translated out of it.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to unlock real-time translation.
upgrade.body: Auto-translate WhatsApp conversations between your team's language and your customers' languages.
